title: Agent permission requests answered by policy, not an env var
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Replace SUSI_ACP_AUTO_APPROVE with a decision from the privacy posture and the action's risk (read-only auto-approved, mutating asks or denies). Tests zc_agent_approvals_*.
